spans.s:
मोद m. (-दः)
 1. Joy, delight, happiness.
 2. Fragrance.
 E. मुद् to rejoice,
aff. घञ् ।

मोदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, rejoicing, causing happiness or de-
light.
 mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of sweetmeat.
 m. (-कः) A mixed caste.
E. मुद् to be glad, in the causal form, to make glad, and ण्वुल् aff.

मोदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Delighting, pleasing.
 f. (-न्ती)
 1. Arabian
jasmine.
 2. A wild sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
 E. मुद् to
be pleased, causal form, aff. शतृ ।

मोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, delighted.
 n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight.
E. मुद् to rejoice, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
